entries.what: Heron & Grind is open on the holiday, with the extended hours still new, and Jun works his shift pulling shots. Between rushes he drafts a pork-and-shrimp prep list for Lola's Roll on his cracked phone.
entries.outcome: Got through the holiday rush and finished the prep list.

entries.what: Afternoon at Tess's house, he helps her sort the coworker lumpia order list on the fridge, and she mentions her knee while they roll.
entries.outcome: Rolled a small batch and kept the order list current.

entries.what: Closing shift at Heron & Grind. He restocks oat milk this time and runs the new 9 p.m. close with Linh.
Late night at the Ruel Road station he fills up the hatchback, then eats al pastor at Taquería Colima.
Views a sublet room in a fourplex off Vinca Avenue and signs the lease right after the one viewing. Afterward he asks the assistant whether $950 a month fits his budget.
entries.outcome: Lease signed; rent math to work out later.

entries.what: Shift at Heron & Grind where students cram for midterms along the vault wall. He makes lattes for the rush and shows Linh a tulip pour.
Morning shift. Wes comes in for his cortado and Jun tells him about moving out.
entries.outcome: Wes tipped in quarters and wished him luck.

entries.what: Evening he starts boxing up his bedroom at Tess's house while OPM ballads play on the speaker. Tess hovers in the doorway.
entries.outcome: Half the room packed; Tess says little.

entries.what: Before his shift he asks the assistant to fix a formula in the sales tab of Linh's sheet, insisting the color coding stay untouched.
entries.outcome: Formula fixed with the colors intact.

entries.what: Commissary Friday block at the Ruel Road kitchen, where he fries a test batch and scrubs the fryer area to dodge Joan's fee.
entries.outcome: No penalty and a clean fryer.

entries.what: Hears from Paolo that he can't help move tomorrow because of his closing shifts.
Moves into the fourplex sublet off Vinca Avenue, carrying boxes from Tess's house in his hatchback. The room has a shared bathroom and street parking only; rent is $950 due on the 1st by Zelle.
Sitting among boxes, he asks the assistant how to tell Tess he is not quitting coffee for nursing, just leaving home.
entries.outcome: Drafted a warm text to Tess.

entries.what: Saturday lumpia table at Heron & Grind in the morning, with Wes buying his two lumpia.
Sunday sleep-in at the new room, then he tries the turon filling in his borrowed space.
Dinner at Tess's house, where she hands him leftover lumpia and critiques the filling.

new_facts.value: shares the fourplex with a quiet nurse named Dee

new_facts.value: borrowed a hand truck from Tess's neighbor for the move

new_facts.value: plans to buy a small shelf for the sublet room next weekend
